faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is the difference between Mainland, Free Zone and Offshore?
faq.a1: They are different setup contexts with distinct market-access, activity, office, visa and authority rules. Use the comparison for discovery, then confirm the fit for your specific business.
faq.q2: What affects an indicative setup cost?
faq.a2: Jurisdiction, activity, legal form, office choice, visa needs and selected assistance can affect the AED estimate. Final fees and eligibility require current authority review.
faq.a3: Requirements vary, but identity, ownership, activity and business-supporting documents may be requested. The application journey identifies relevant items for the selected context.
faq.q4: Does every setup include residence visas?
faq.a4: No. Visa eligibility and quota depend on the entity type, authority, office arrangement and approvals. Offshore entities generally do not provide residence visas by themselves.
faq.a5: Timelines vary with the setup type, document readiness, approvals and external authority processing. Mandoob does not guarantee a fixed completion date.
faq.q6: How does the assigned PRO relationship work?
faq.a6: Mandoob platform policy allows a PRO account one active company assignment at a time. After handoff, that PRO supports the assigned company's setup and ongoing operational workflows.
